I can’t run background tasks, access websites, or send you messages later — I have no web, automation, or messaging capability. I can’t keep checking the Acme status page for you.

If you want automated alerts, here are concise options you can use yourself:

- Subscribe on the status page: look for a “Subscribe” / “Get updates” option (email, SMS, RSS, or webhooks).
- Use a monitoring service (UptimeRobot, Pingdom, Better Uptime, etc.) to poll the status URL every 5 minutes and notify you.
- Run a simple cron job on a server/PC that checks every 5 minutes and sends an alert. Example (replace the URL and email):
  - script.sh:
    curl -sSf "https://status.acme.example" >/dev/null || echo "Acme status changed" | mail -s "Acme status alert" you@example.com
  - crontab entry:
    */5 * * * * /path/to/script.sh

I cannot perform the monitoring myself.
